_comment: Non-copyrighted E08 summary over the preserved external contact/hazard frame index.
bounded_conclusions: All 3,364 retained actor-change records join to measured authored source identities; no fixture filename supplies the type word.
Seven of the 28 uncontrolled classes occur in actor-change records; five have HP/flags/source/identity/callback or knockback-activation boundaries.
Type 0x1b1f knockback activation shares two LEVEL11 frame boundaries with player health loss and is a priority lead, not causal or semantic ownership proof.
The four retained live typed boundaries reproduce at frame granularity, independently cross-checking their HP/flag leaves.
Top-block aggregation is limited to the index's retained per-frame leaders and is passive block-start evidence, not an every-cycle trace.
live_escalation_decision: No live run: the current queue had no offline-ready row, E08 was the highest-ranked unconsumed subsystem-sized partial cluster, and its retained capsules answered the iteration's prioritization questions.

named_unknowns.authored_state: Native switch/gate/mover state, initialization, capacity, retirement, denial and success behavior remain untyped.
named_unknowns.lifecycle: Checkpoint, death, reload, transition and save/load persistence/reset remain untested for E08 interaction state.
named_unknowns.native_controls: The five newly prioritized classes still lack positive/negative native counterfactual controls; frame correlation does not consume this gap.
named_unknowns.ownership: Final ownership remains unknown for the 19 outcome-controlled unowned classes and all 28 uncontrolled classes.
named_unknowns.precision: The capsules do not expose exact writer instructions/cycles, DMA/GPU submission, or SPU voice attribution.

selection_snapshot.selection_reason: No offline-ready or live-required row exists. E08 is the highest-ranked unconsumed subsystem-sized partial cluster: all 13 relevant capsules and 156 scheduled queries share the already-preserved contact/hazard index. Higher-ranked C16/C15 have only three/one capsules and have already been repeatedly deepened; E10 already consumed this same corpus.
